content:
name: Temporary post-WP0004 reconciliation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - reconcile/post-wp-mvp-0004
    paths:
      - .eos/post-wp0004-reconciliation-trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  reconcile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact reconciliation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Validate and finalize reconciliation
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD: e9209fc523d3d925e772c7da6a595bfb136799f2
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD" HEAD

          rm .github/workflows/temporary-post-wp0004-reconciliation.yml
          rm .eos/post-wp0004-reconciliation-trigger

          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0003 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0005
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0004 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0009

          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

          grep -q '^\*\*Current packet:\*\* WP-MVP-0005 — REFINED; Ready gate not yet executed' engineering/project-status.md
          grep -q '^\*\*Status:\*\* Refined — prerequisites satisfied; Ready gate not yet executed' engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0005.md
          grep -q 'ADR-0005 is Accepted' engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0005.md
          ! grep -q 'blocked from Ready by WP-MVP-0001/WP-MVP-0003 and ADR-0005' engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0005.md
          ! grep -q 'proposed ADR-0005' engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0005.md

          python3 - <<'PY'
          import csv
          from pathlib import Path

          wp_rows = {r['id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(Path('.eos/work-packets.tsv').open(), delimiter='\t')}
          for wp_id in ('WP-MVP-0001', 'WP-MVP-0002', 'WP-MVP-0003', 'WP-MVP-0004'):
              assert wp_rows[wp_id]['status'] == 'CLOSED', (wp_id, wp_rows[wp_id]['status'])
          assert 'WP-MVP-0005' not in wp_rows, wp_rows.get('WP-MVP-0005')

          wc_rows = {r['id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(Path('.eos/work-cycles.tsv').open(), delimiter='\t')}
          assert wc_rows['WC-MVP-0002']['status'] == 'ACTIVE', wc_rows['WC-MVP-0002']
          pi_rows = {r['id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(Path('.eos/program-increments.tsv').open(), delimiter='\t')}
          assert pi_rows['PI-MVP-001']['status'] == 'ACTIVE', pi_rows['PI-MVP-001']

          ev_rows = list(csv.DictReader(Path('.eos/evidence.tsv').open(), delimiter='\t'))
          for wp_id in ('WP-MVP-0001', 'WP-MVP-0002', 'WP-MVP-0003', 'WP-MVP-0004'):
              current = [r for r in ev_rows if r['target'] == wp_id and r['status'] != 'SUPERSEDED']
              assert len(current) == 3, (wp_id, current)
              assert all(r['status'] == 'VALIDATED' for r in current), (wp_id, current)
              assert all(r['result'] in {'PASSED', 'SKIPPED'} for r in current), (wp_id, current)
          PY

          mapfile -t changed < <({ git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u)
          test "${#changed[@]}" -gt 0
          for f in "${changed[@]}"; do
            case "$f" in
              engineering/project-status.md|engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0005.md|engineering/evidence/*|.eos/*|machine/*) ;;
              *) echo "Out-of-scope reconciliation path: $f" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
          done

          git config user.name "ChatGPT"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git commit -m "docs(engineering): finalize post-WP-MVP-0004 reconciliation"
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
